$comment: Generated from the Factory file parser and the catalogues its apply path validates against. Edit logic/factoryfile/schema, then regenerate; a hand edit is reverted by the drift test.
title: webhooks/<name>.yaml (v1alpha1)
description: A custom webhook source document. The source's name comes from the file name, never from a field. The source's signing secret is never authored here and the server never generates one for a file-declared source: secretName is required in every authMode and must reference an existing managed secret holding the source's signing secret or bearer token.

authMode.description: How the source authenticates deliveries. Defaults to token when omitted.

signatureScheme.description: Provider-native signature scheme this source verifies. Required when authMode is signature; invalid otherwise.

secretName.description: Name of a managed secret holding the source's signing secret or bearer token. Required in every authMode: the server never generates or reveals a secret for a file-declared source.

deliveryIdHeader.description: Header this sender stamps its own delivery identity into. Omit when the sender declares none. Must be a valid HTTP header name and must not be one whose value could carry a credential (e.g. Authorization, Cookie, or a provider's own signature header).

enabled.description: Defaults to true. Disabling stops ingress immediately without deleting the source.
